verdict.rationale: Aircall publishes no OpenAPI spec: the portal disables the spec download and /openapi.json returns 404. Its machine-readable surface is a vendor-linked Postman collection, which has its own docs page and is arguably an 'equivalent' format, but its content could not be body-verified. missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI (or equally standard) spec, verified content of the Postman collection, independent or hands-on corroboration of a usable download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Aircall's machine-readable surface is its vendor-linked Postman collection
